sections.title: A hotel that makes Lanarkshire and both cities easy
sections.html:
Bentley Hotel sits on High Road at the west end of Motherwell, in a sandstone villa built in 1874 and once known as Motherwell House. It is part of the Hamilton Road Conservation Area. Inside are 18 en-suite bedrooms, a restaurant with its own conservatory, a bar and a function suite.

What brings most people here is where we are. Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk, and the fastest trains reach Glasgow Central in under 20 minutes, with services to Edinburgh, direct trains to London and Manchester and the Caledonian Sleeper. By car, junction 6 of the M74 is close by and the M8 a few miles north; Glasgow is about 12 miles away and Edinburgh about 30.

So whether you are working in Lanarkshire, visiting family, here for a wedding or a match at Fir Park, or heading into Glasgow for the day, you can park with us for free, walk to the station and come back to our own restaurant and bar.

Every room has an en-suite bathroom, a TV, tea and coffee making facilities and free WiFi. The house dates from 1874 and the rooms vary in shape and size, so if a particular bed set-up matters to you, tell us when you book.

sections.title: What you get when you stay

items.title: 5 minutes from the station
items.text: On the West Coast Main Line, about 5 minutes' walk away. Glasgow Central in under 20 minutes at the fastest, with services to Edinburgh, London and Manchester.

items.title: Free parking on site
items.text: Park at the hotel for the length of your stay, whether you are here for a night or a working week. Nothing to pay.

items.title: Restaurant and bar
items.text: Scottish and British cooking in the restaurant and conservatory, with a bar for before or after. Opening times vary, so call ahead.

items.title: Rooms to suit the trip
items.text: Singles for solo travellers and contractors, twins for colleagues or friends, doubles for couples and a family room for up to three.

sections.title: Choose the room that fits
sections.intro: All en suite, with a TV, tea and coffee and free WiFi. The difference is the beds.

items.image_alt: Two single beds with teal throws and a colourful canvas on the wall
items.title: Twin Room
items.text: Two single beds for friends or colleagues sharing.

items.image_alt: A double bed and a single bed in white linen against a sage wall
items.title: Family Room
items.text: A double bed and a single bed, so parents and a child, or three people travelling together, can share one room.

sections.title: Staying in Motherwell: what people ask us

items.a: At 19 High Road, Motherwell ML1 3HU, at the west end of the town. Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk and the North Lanarkshire Heritage Centre is next door. By road, leave the M74 at junction 6 (A723) and follow the signs for Motherwell.
Yes. There is free parking on site for guests, for the whole of your stay.
It depends on the rate you book, so check your confirmation or ask us. When it is included, it’s a full Scottish breakfast cooked to order. Not sure? Call us on 01698 265588 and we’ll check.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: Check-in is from 2pm and check-out is by 11am. The main guest checking in must be 18 or over. If you expect to arrive late in the evening, please let us know in advance.

items.q: How do I get into Glasgow or Edinburgh?
items.a: By train from Motherwell station, about 5 minutes’ walk away: Glasgow Central in under 20 minutes at the fastest, with services to Edinburgh too. By car, Glasgow is about 12 miles and Edinburgh about 30.
